description: Sanz Rodrigo, Javier and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The collection provides benchmark inputs and simulation datasets for assessment of wind-farm array efficiency. It accompanies the Offshore Wind Accelerator challenge and is intended for use with separately published OWAbench evaluation scripts. The described benchmark spans five offshore wind farms, with operational observations supporting comparison of meso-wake models. The deposit does not imply unrestricted access to every original operator signal or identical input completeness at each farm. Data and evaluation software are linked as distinct objects, and no benchmark was executed during this review. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
